picks.headline: Intern-S2-Preview Introduces 397B Foundation Model for Scientific Agents
picks.why: It introduces a massive 397B open backbone and unified post-training system optimized for multimodal scientific reasoning and long-horizon tasks.
picks.title: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model

picks.headline: Inaudible Low-Frequency Audio Signals Cause Large Audio-Language Model Failures
picks.why: It demonstrates a practical black-box signal attack that degrades audio-language model safety using inaudible sound frequencies.
picks.title: From Inaudible Inputs to Model Failures: Low-Frequency Safety Risks in LALMs

picks.headline: Google Kubernetes Engine Adds ClusterNetworkPolicy for Cluster-Wide Traffic Security
picks.why: It gives platform teams overarching network security enforcement across GKE clusters without stripping tenant namespace autonomy.
picks.title: ClusterNetworkPolicy in GKE: Balancing control and autonomy for your microservices

picks.headline: TEMPO Optimizes MoE Execution via Makespan-Aware Expert Parallel Dispatching
picks.why: It reduces Mixture-of-Experts inference latency by jointly modeling memory-bound weight streaming and compute-bound tile padding.
picks.title: TEMPO: Makespan-Aware Expert-Parallel Load Balancing Across Memory- and Compute-Bound Regimes

papers.headline: Neural Quadratic Forms Model Explains Sudden Learning and Power-Law Scaling
papers.why: It uses Lotka-Volterra dynamics to mathematically unify both abrupt step-like capability jumps and smooth power-law scaling in neural networks.
papers.title: Neural Quadratic Forms: A Unified Minimal Model for Sudden Learning and Scaling Laws

papers.headline: Probes for Evaluation Awareness Measure Prompt Phrasing Over Model Properties
papers.why: It reveals that linear probes designed to detect model self-awareness track prompt formulation artifacts rather than true internal awareness.
papers.title: A Probe Direction Is a Property of Its Prompt

papers.headline: Synthetic Persona Pretraining Embeds Value Alignment Before Post-Training Starts
papers.why: It proves that embedding normative reflection annotations directly into pretraining data substantially improves downstream jailbreak robustness.
papers.title: Synthetic Persona Pretraining: Alignment from Token Zero
